tour.cities_tail: and more Polish cities, with all of Europe coming soon 🇪🇺

intro.title: Welcome to Trasa!
intro.desc: Trasa is speed dating with the city. In a few minutes you'll build a day plan: browse places, add the ones that intrigue you and get a ready-made route.

cities.title: To start: Polish cities
cities.desc: We're starting with Warsaw and Gdańsk, and new cities keep arriving. Trasa keeps growing - soon you'll plan trips across all of Europe.

plan.title: Plan solo or with a group
plan.desc: Tap + on the bar and choose: plan solo, invite a group with a code or join friends. You browse places, and Trasa gathers your picks.

route.title: Your route on the map
route.desc: From your picks Trasa builds a day plan in the right order and shows it on the map. You can refine the plan and save it to your memories.
route.highlight: You navigate point to point via Google Maps.
